metadata.description: mind-atlas: an agent skill that maps a project or topic into an interactive multi-level HTML mind map

plugins.name: mind-atlas
plugins.description: Decide what the map is for (learning, project tracking or a decision), pick a level from overview to panorama, research branches with read-only sub-agents, build a single-file HTML mind map that opens with a double-click, collect feedback on the map itself, and keep a project-tracking map from going stale with a console and a build-time check. English and Chinese interface. For Claude Code and Codex.
